payroll tax.disposition: SDCL 10-45-96; PEO sales-tax deduction for payroll-tax disbursements, not municipal taxing authority

local income tax.disposition: SDCL 48-7-105 and 48-7-305; generic partnership recordkeeping references, not South Dakota local-tax authorization

relevant_framework: South Dakota Constitution article IX section 2 grants broad home-rule power.
SDCL 10-52-1 and 10-52-2 use broad municipal non-ad-valorem language.
SDCL 10-52-9 requires advance notice to the Secretary of Revenue for every new or amended chapter 10-52 municipal tax ordinance.
SDCL 6-12-14 restricts new local taxes similar to taxes producing state revenue unless statute specifically provides otherwise.
SDCL 10-64-1 states that South Dakota has no income tax.
The July 2026 DOR municipal-tax guide recognizes sales/use and gross-receipts taxes and identifies no employee wage-tax category or adopter.
